verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents an official CLI, but its documented scope is local preview, real-time testing and catching build errors before deploy. Nothing shows the CLI exposes AI-native or agent-oriented workflows; Mintlify's agentic surfaces are the MCP servers, editor agent and REST API, not the CLI. missing for 10: evidence of AI- or agent-oriented CLI commands, documentation of the CLI command set beyond preview and build checks, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install the Mintlify CLI to preview documentation locally, test changes in real time, and catch build errors before deploying to production.
